attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster on node1, node2, node3 (Alpine 3.23, MariaDB 11.4.12 + Galera 26.4.13). Writes on any member replicate to the others (multi-master verified). The cluster stays available on 2/3 quorum when one member is stopped or rebooted, and a returning member auto-resyncs its data (verified via graceful stop/start and via full OS reboot for all three nodes). All three nodes were individually rebooted one at a time, quorum preserved throughout, each showing a changed OS boot_id and full cluster/data recovery afterward.
